mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5%, it signals a tight labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances with UNRATE < 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with both HOUST and RSAFS rising, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL growth rate > 2.5% y/y), a rising CPI signals impending monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with CPIAUCSL growth > 2.5% y/y, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with PAYEMS growth, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing and services, reducing corporate profitability and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with INDPRO < 90.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates a robust economic expansion that together drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with GDPC1 growth > 2.0% and HOUST rise > 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL growth rate < 1.5% y/y), a rising CPI signals recovery in price pressures that supports economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances with CPIAUCSL growth < 1.5% y/y, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
